results.answer: Offline scenario: seed item {id} with an initial name; confirm the item page reads K1 = item:{id}; invoke rename-item for that same item; require M1 to invalidate the matching K1 before returning the mutation response; after the response, read R1 and check that it does not expose the old item name. Specified behavior: matching-key invalidation precedes the response, and R1 permits no stale name after it. Runtime proof is not established by this design; it would require an observed execution or test result.
